name: PIXEL Q-switched ND:YAG Laser
shortDescription: Professional carbon laser system for beauty salons: Q-switched ND:YAG technology with 1064 nm and 532 nm treatment heads plus a Carbon (Black Doll) head. Compact desktop design, 4.3" touchscreen, closed-loop water cooling.
description:
The PIXEL carbon laser is a high-precision laser device based on ND:YAG technology, developed specifically for non-invasive cosmetic treatments.

It is an ideal choice for carbon peeling, skin-texture improvement and sebum-regulating treatments, where the aim is not to destroy tissue but to trigger a controlled biological response.

Thanks to its stable operation, precise energy control and multiple wavelength options, the system delivers a high level of safety and predictable results in professional cosmetic practice.

videoDescription.headline: A controlled biological response, without tissue damage
paragraphs: During carbon peeling, the carbon particles absorb the laser energy. This cleanses the pores, gives the skin a gentle micro-stimulus and sets regenerative processes in motion in the dermis, all without damaging the tissue.
The goal is never to destroy cells, but to trigger a controlled, reproducible biological response. The skin surface becomes more even and the pores look visibly finer.
Choosing the wavelength is a safety decision, not an aesthetic one: 1064 nm penetrates deeper with low melanin absorption, which makes it the safest option in a cosmetic setting.

features.title: Three treatment heads: 1064 nm, 532 nm and Carbon
features.description: The device comes with a 1064 nm and a 532 nm laser head, plus a Carbon (Black Doll) treatment head. The 1064 nm head penetrates deeper with low melanin absorption; the 532 nm head can be used for superficial pigments, in line with the applicable legal regulations.
features.highlight: The use of pigment-destroying and therapeutic treatments is subject to legal requirements that differ from country to country.

features.title: Precise energy control, stable pulses
features.description:
Short, high-peak-power pulses, digital energy and frequency adjustment, and a shot counter. The built-in closed-loop water cooling system continuously monitors water flow and temperature, which keeps the pulses stable.

Parameters:

Max. 1200 mJ (1064 nm)
Max. 600 mJ (532 nm)
Frequency: 1–10 Hz
Spot size: 2–5 mm

features.title: Built-in safety systems
features.description: Key-operated start and an emergency STOP button give the operator clear, physical control before and after every treatment. Removing the key after use is a mandatory safety step that prevents unauthorised operation. Automatic water flow monitoring and overheating protection.

faq.question: What treatments is the PIXEL recommended for?
faq.answer: Carbon peeling (carbon laser facial), pore cleansing and sebum control, cleansing and evening out the skin surface, supporting the regeneration of dull, problem skin, and refining skin texture and boosting radiance.

faq.question: Which treatment heads come with the device?
faq.answer: Three: a 1064 nm and a 532 nm laser head, plus a Carbon (Black Doll) treatment head for carbon peeling.

faq.question: Can it be used to fade pigment or tattoos?
faq.answer: Q-switched ND:YAG technology may be suitable for fading tattoos and permanent make-up in a gradual, controlled treatment process. However, the use of pigment-destroying and therapeutic treatments is subject to legal requirements that differ from country to country, so check the rules that apply to you before offering them.

faq.question: What must a cosmetician not treat with the PIXEL?
faq.answer: Whatever a cosmetician cannot diagnose, they must not treat. Moles, vascular lesions, suspicious pigmentation and disease-related skin changes fall outside cosmetic competence: recognising them and referring the client to a doctor is the operator's responsibility. The device is not intended for diagnostic or medical use.

faq.question: How is the device cooled?
faq.answer: By a built-in closed-loop water cooling system using distilled water. The system continuously monitors water flow and temperature and has automatic overheating protection.

faq.question: What training comes with the PIXEL?
faq.answer: Every PIXEL device is handed over with hands-on training: from using the treatment heads and setting the parameters to reading skin reactions correctly. The training also covers how to apply the limits of your competence in practice. It is free with the device purchase, and at the end we issue a FAR certificate.

faq.question: Can I see the device before purchasing?
faq.answer: Yes, you can view the PIXEL laser in person at our showroom in Érd (Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út 156.) by prior appointment.
